whenToUse: A moving, cleaning or home-service company that quotes by job size, date and extras.
Service businesses that want a multi-step quote calculator with a live price range.
avoidWhen: Trades selling standard products from a catalogue — use site-wholesale-01.
Clinics booking appointment slots — use site-physio-01.
a11y: The live estimate is a role="status" aria-live region, and motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.
Keep each calculator step's fields labelled and announce step changes to screen readers.
